summary: Iteration 2 (auth, roles, editable masters, share board, export, gsheets no-op) verified end-to-end. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_iter2.py. Frontend: all 15 critical UI checks pass — owner login, role-based nav, dealer-earnings route protection, price-master add/edit/delete flow, scheme-master add flow, Settings page (Google Sheet 'Not configured' badge, /share link, owner-only User Accounts card with add-user working), executive restrictions (nav hidden, direct URL redirected, Settings hides User Accounts), public /share renders without login, logout returns to /login, export button hits /api/export and returns a valid 11.7KB .xlsx blob with correct openxml content-type, regression (dashboard KPIs + Lead Register) still green.

issues: 'Welcome back' success toast is positioned in the top-right and overlaps the Export button for ~3s after login. Real users can still click after the toast auto-dismisses, but the overlap makes the button momentarily hard to hit (Playwright force-click at element coords was intercepted; JS .click() worked). Consider anchoring toasts below the topbar or reducing default duration.

action_items: (Optional polish) Move toast container below the topbar or shorten the default toast duration so the 'Welcome back' notification doesn't overlap the Export button after login.
(Optional cleanup) After testing, delete leftover TEST_ users and TEST_UIModel price/scheme rows created by the UI tests (see seed_data_creation).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown from ~745 to ~920 lines with auth + masters CRUD + export + share. Still over the 700-line guideline — split into routers/auth_routes.py (already partly in auth.py), routers/masters.py (price+scheme CRUD), routers/exports.py (xlsx), and routers/public.py (/share).
GET /api/export loads whole collections into memory and generates the whole xlsx in-request. Fine at current volume; add pagination/streaming or a background job when leads > 5k.
auth.py: JWT_SECRET is read via os.environ['JWT_SECRET'] with no default. Good (fails fast). Consider adding a startup assertion so the failure surfaces at boot, not on first login.

auth.py: seed_users always upserts the owner password to match env — good idempotency. The demo executive is only inserted if missing; if OWNER_PASSWORD is rotated the executive's password will NOT re-sync. Acceptable for a fixed demo account.
auth.py returns bcrypt hashes from a synchronous bcrypt.hashpw inside an async function — blocking for O(100ms) per login/create; fine at low QPS, would need to be moved to a thread pool at scale.

gsheets.py append() correctly no-ops when unconfigured; ensure exceptions inside append are swallowed (log-only) so a bad credential can never break lead creation. Currently a network failure inside gspread would propagate — wrap in try/except at the append() call sites or inside the module.

Owner-only user delete does not prevent deleting the last remaining owner. If the sole owner deletes themselves via userId change or a data script, the org would be locked out. Add a guard: 'Cannot delete the last owner'.

Excel export is protected by current_user (any authenticated role can export). Business intent says Executives should not access Dealer Earnings; the export sheet includes Price Master/Bookings/Payments which is arguably fine for exec, but consider gating /api/export to owner_only if company financial detail should stay owner-scoped.
CORS in server.py uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False. Fine because auth is done via Bearer header, not cookies. Confirmed no cookies are set.
test_credentials: Owner owner@euler.com/euler@123 and Executive executive@euler.com/euler@123 both seed correctly on startup and log in through /api/auth/login.
seed_data_creation: Backend test suite created + deleted a temporary owner-managed executive user (test_<uuid>@euler.com) and a TEST_Model price row + scheme row (all deleted at end). It also created a lead 'TEST_GSheetsNoop' with a 100 INR Cash payment to prove gsheets no-op is graceful. UI test left behind: (a) a TEST_UIModel price row (not deleted after edit), (b) a TEST_UIModel scheme row, (c) two executive users test_fee6b2c3@euler.com and test_ui_1786018500@euler.com (visible on Settings). Main agent can reseed via POST /api/admin/reseed if a clean baseline is needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pytest files exist and both should be run on the next iteration: /app/backend/tests/test_euler_crm.py (iter1 core CRM regression, 30 tests) and /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_iter2.py (auth/roles/masters/export/share, 23 tests). Auth uses Bearer JWT; use fixtures owner_token / exec_token. Frontend login redirects to '/' (root), not '/dashboard', so wait_for_url should check absence of '/login' rather than presence of '/dashboard'. Export button is fired via JS blob-anchor click — Playwright's expect_download does not fire; verify by monitoring the /api/export response (200 + openxml content-type + >500 bytes body) instead. Public /share is fully unauthenticated (backend /api/share/dashboard requires no token). Google Sheets sync is intentionally NOT configured — /api/integrations/gsheets returns enabled=false and record creation still succeeds. No known blockers.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no failing tests. One non-blocking design observation: the 'Welcome back' toast overlays the topbar Export button after login. Reproduction: log in as owner, immediately (<3s) click 'Export' in top-right — the toast can intercept the click. Mitigation: move toast container below the topbar or shorten duration to 2s. Also, Playwright expect_download() will not fire on this app's blob-URL download path — assert via /api/export response instead.
